methodology: Fixed semantic fixtures rendered through the baseline and current presenters. Synthetic timestamps/event IDs normalized for repeatability. Calls count the explicitly scripted paths to acquire the same task/answer/range facts; this is an output benchmark, not native Runtime performance.

findTaskAndResult.explanation: Baseline text list has no title, so the scripted caller repeats the list as JSON to identify the task; the current title removes that call.

waitAnswerContinue.explanation: Baseline text omits the question/choices and requires a result query before submitting the same response. Current text supplies them; response ownership/authorization remains unchanged.

readLargeBoard.explanation: The baseline caller repeats the first read as JSON to discover truncation and the next byte offset. Current text carries the range/continuation, and both paths reconstruct identical UTF-8 content.
